messages:
alex: Heads-up — acceptance CI on main is red, a bunch of tests failing that touch the mock-redis fixture. Job: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/11723 :warning:
ci-bot: build #11723 failed: 22 tests failing. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/11723/logs
nina: I noticed something similar yesterday afternoon — the redis-mock pods were restarting and coming up empty (keys missing). I called it 'nodes amnesia' lol.
ryan: @eng-infra can we check kube events for the redis-mock pods? wondering if it's OOM / kubelet evicting.
sasha: quick grep of the logs shows an OOM kill around 10:32:15: `Killed process 1 (redis-server) total-vm:512000kB` — looks like a memory pressure crash.
lee: I repro'd locally with `scripts/ci/run_integration.sh --fixture=redis-mock` — the process gets killed under the default job memory.
ryan: pulling events now, snippet: ```
Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
----    ------     ---   ----               -------
Warning OOMKilling 3m    kubelet, ip-10-0  Killed container with out-of-memory
```
ryan: pod redis-mock-4 restarted 4x in 3m; container_restart_count=4.
alex: For a fast unblock I'm going to pin the CI job to the previous redis-mock image (redwood/redis-mock:20240207-abc123) and trigger a rerun.
nina: sounds good. Also suggest marking the flaky key-expiry tests with `@flaky-on-ci` so they don't block release while infra is investigated.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @alex: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/11724 (re-run of 11723)
sasha: FWIW, there was a config tweak merged last week that changed maxmemory-policy to noeviction in redis-mock — that would make memory blowups more likely.
alex: Created INFRA-721 and assigned to @ryan. Notes: check node kubelet eviction thresholds, container memory limits, and whether the redis-mock image change removed LRU settings.
ryan: I'll take it. ETA ~60m, will report back with root cause and a permanent mitigation.
nina: Immediate temporary mitigation if you need a quick fix: increase the CI job memory or set env REDIS_MOCK_MAX_MEMORY=256mb for the fixture.
alex: Patch opened to CI config: https://ci.internal/redwood/patches/542 — pinned image + bumped memory.
ryan: Update: found kubelet eviction config set aggressively on the CI nodes and redis-mock containers lacked memory limits, so kubelet was evicting on pressure. Pushing a patch to add memory requests/limits + a livenessProbe to the fixture.
alex: Thanks — monitoring build 11724 now. :eyes:
ci-bot: build #11724 succeeded (all tests green)
